attributes.name: payload
attributes.description: Decoded sid_demo TLV uplink. Fields below populate from on-board sensors on each action notification.

childs.name: id
childs.description: sid_demo msg_desc decoded as opc-cmd_class-cmd_id. 2-0-0 is a capability frame, 2-0-1 is an action frame.

childs.name: Sequence
childs.description: Uplink sequence counter from the firmware (TLV tag 0x21). Wraps at 256.

childs.name: Sinewave
childs.description: Reserved sid_demo template field, always 0 for this firmware. Kept for dashboard compatibility.

childs.name: version
childs.description: IKS4A1 firmware payload schema version (TLV tag 0x20).

childs.name: payload_size
childs.description: Total uplink size in bytes. ~14 bytes for capability frames, ~61 bytes for action frames with all sensors present.

childs.name: sensor_data
childs.description: Whole-degree STTS22H temperature in C from sid_demo tag 0x06. Same value as temp_stts22h_c rounded to int.

childs.name: Temperature
childs.description: Whole-degree STTS22H temperature in C as a decimal. Same value as sensor_data. Surfaced for the standard /IOTCONNECT Temperature widget.

childs.name: gps_time
childs.description: GPS time at uplink (TLV tag 0x07), seconds since the Sidewalk GPS epoch. 0 if the device has not yet time-synced.

childs.name: link_type
childs.description: Sidewalk link the uplink traversed (TLV tag 0x0C). Always BLE for the sid_ble app.

childs.name: acc_x_g
childs.description: LSM6DSV16X X-axis acceleration in g (TLV tag 0x22).

childs.name: acc_y_g
childs.description: LSM6DSV16X Y-axis acceleration in g (TLV tag 0x22).

childs.name: acc_z_g
childs.description: LSM6DSV16X Z-axis acceleration in g (TLV tag 0x22). ~+1 g when the board is face-up flat on a desk.

childs.name: gyr_x_dps
childs.description: LSM6DSV16X X-axis angular rate in dps (TLV tag 0x23). Near zero when still.

childs.name: gyr_y_dps
childs.description: LSM6DSV16X Y-axis angular rate in dps (TLV tag 0x23).

childs.name: gyr_z_dps
childs.description: LSM6DSV16X Z-axis angular rate in dps (TLV tag 0x23).

childs.name: temp_stts22h_c
childs.description: High-resolution STTS22H temperature in C (TLV tag 0x24, 0.01 C resolution). The IKS4A1 dedicated temperature die.

childs.name: temp_sht40_c
childs.description: SHT40AD1B temperature in C (TLV tag 0x25, 0.01 C resolution). Co-located with the humidity sensor.

childs.name: humidity_sht40_pct
childs.description: SHT40AD1B relative humidity in percent (TLV tag 0x26, 0.01 percent resolution).

childs.name: pressure_hpa
childs.description: LPS22DF barometric pressure in hPa (TLV tag 0x27, 0.01 hPa resolution). Typical sea-level value 1013 hPa.

childs.name: orientation
childs.description: LSM6DSV16X native 6D engine output (TLV tag 0x28). One of: face_up, face_down, portrait_up, portrait_down, landscape_left, landscape_right, unknown.

childs.name: qvar
childs.description: LIS2DUXS12 Qvar raw count (TLV tag 0x29, signed int16). Capacitive variation on the IKS4A1 edge pads; swings hundreds-to-thousands when a finger touches a pad.

attributes.name: decoder_name
attributes.description: Name of the /IOTCONNECT decoder that produced the record. Always sidewalk-iks4a1-tlv for this template.
